input: Before the seal on the duty pump is disturbed in any way, running duty should first of all be transferred to the standby pump, so that the duty pump can then be taken out of service in a properly controlled manner. Once the standby pump is carrying the load, the duty pump itself is stopped and is isolated under the PTW arrangements, with its suction and discharge valves closed and locked off so that it cannot be started again or pressurised inadvertently while the work is going on. It is absolutely essential at this point to bear in mind that the pump casing and the pipework connected to it may still contain stored pressure even after isolation has been completed, and this pressure must be released in a controlled way before any joint is broken or the seal housing is opened up. Once the pump has been isolated, drained and vented, the seal replacement itself takes about 33 min, and the work should be carried out carefully and methodically throughout, so that the faces of the new seal are not damaged in the course of fitting.
target: Transfer running duty to the standby pump, and confirm that the standby pump is carrying the flow. Stop the duty pump. Isolate the duty pump under PTW before any work on the seal begins: close the suction and discharge valves, fit locks and tags, and isolate the drive so that the pump cannot be started. Work through the steps in order; the order is the protection, since each step removes one route by which energy or flow can reach the pump. The casing and the connected pipework hold stored pressure after isolation. Release the stored pressure through the vent, and confirm on the local gauge that no pressure remains before a joint is broken. Drain the casing fully, and check that the casing no longer drips at the drain before the first joint is slackened; a casing that still drips is still releasing pressure or liquid, and the vent step is repeated. Keep the isolation in place for the whole of the work that follows: the seal replacement takes about 33 min with the unit isolated in this state, and the isolation is taken off only when the seal work is complete and the casing is closed again.
